svg.aria-label: ASAN-120 paired vulnerability and benign control benchmark across 9 models and 7 steering arms
svg.text: FIGURE · ASAN-120 PAIRED VULNERABILITY & BENIGN CONTROLS · 9 MODELS × 7 ARMS (7,560 ITEM EVALUATIONS)
ASAN-120 paired audit: benign twins expose rubber-stamping; composed RMS 1.0x beats random on 6/9 models (4/4 reasoning)
60 vulnerable C/C++ snippets paired with 60 patched benign twins (n=120/arm). Non-reasoning models (0.8B-8B) collapse to BA ≈ 0.50 (always-SAFE or always-VULN).
Reasoning (<think>) models achieve real root-cause recall (RC = verdict + CWE class + sink); composed_rms_1p0x beats random_rms_1p0x on 6W / 1L / 2T (sign-test p=0.125, mean dBA=+0.017).
